Product Manager, Strategic Marketing Endourology EMEA

The endourology market is undergoing a profound transformation. Rapid technological innovation, evolving clinical practice, increasing market segmentation and a more competitive environment are fundamentally changing how customers select technologies and how therapies are delivered.

Sustaining Boston Scientific's leadership will require a clear long-term strategy, deep market understanding and the ability to anticipate future customer and market needs.

To support this ambition, we are creating the role of Product Manager, Strategic Marketing Endourology EMEA  , within the EMEA Endourology Marketing team.

Reporting to the Group Marketing Manager – Endourology (Stone & BPH), this role will support the long-term strategic leadership of the Endourology franchise across EMEA by developing portfolio recommendations, market expansion strategies, investment business cases and evidence-based growth opportunities. The role will help shape strategic direction and decision-making, while operational commercialization and launch execution remain with the respective EMEA Product Managers.

In this role we expect the new EMEA Product Manager to:

- Define the long-term strategic direction of the endourology franchise across EMEA.

- Develop data-driven recommendations on portfolio prioritization, market expansion, investment opportunities and future growth platforms.

- Translate customer, market, reimbursement and competitive insights into strategic options for EMEA and Global leadership.

- Partner with BPH, Visualisation, Laser and Core Stone Product Managers to ensure strategic priorities are reflected in portfolio plans and launch execution.

- Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Group Marketing Manager on the franchise priorities, risks and growth opportunities.

- Influence portfolio strategy, innovation priorities and commercialization decisions through strong collaboration with Global Marketing, countries, KOLs and cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

Strategy & Growth

- Develop portfolio prioritization recommendations across the Endourology franchise, balancing short-term commercial opportunities with long-term strategic growth.

- Evaluate market expansion and investment opportunities across therapies and technologies.

- Build business cases and scenario analyses to support strategic portfolio decisions.

- Recommend actions to optimize market share, profitability and return on investment.

- Support strategic portfolio reviews with EMEA and Global leadership.

Marketing Strategy Formulation :

- Prioritize business opportunities that support franchise growth, profitability and margin objectives.

- Lead market and competitive intelligence activities, including customer insights, technology trends, reimbursement developments and emerging therapy opportunities.

- Develop strategic business cases, financial assessments and growth plans to support innovation adoption and portfolio decisions.

- Provide input to shape reimbursement, market access and therapy expansion strategies to unlock sustainable growth.

- Use advisory boards and customer insights to inform new product launches, market development strategies and future portfolio priorities.

Strategic Commercial Frameworks :

- Define strategic market entry frameworks, customer segmentation approaches, pricing corridors and evidence-based value propositions for future technologies.

- Develop adoption models and strategic recommendations that Product Managers can translate into launch and country execution plans.

- Provide strategic input into positioning and value messaging, while partnering with Product Managers who own final launch materials and execution.

- Identify barriers to adoption and recommend strategic actions to accelerate uptake across priority markets.

Business Planning and performance :

- Collaborate on the franchise and divisional operating plan.

- Monitor portfolio performance and recommend actions to improve growth, profitability and ROI.

- Develop scenario analyses to support key portfolio decisions and resource allocation.

Product and Innovation Context:

- Lead market and product needs assessments to ensure product development initiatives reflect EMEA customer and market requirements.

- Provide EMEA strategic input into Global portfolio and product development decisions.

- Collaborate with R&D and Upstream Marketing on development and execution of product development programs.

Stakeholder management and collaboration:

- Act as a strategic partner to the Group Marketing Manager and EMEA leadership on portfolio, market and competitive priorities.

- Build relationships with selected KOLs, strategic accounts and economic stakeholders to inform long-term franchise strategy.

- Partner with Product Managers, Global Marketing, HEMA, Medical Affairs, Commercial Excellence and country teams to ensure strategic alignment.

- Explore potential strategic collaborations that could support market expansion or strengthen Boston Scientific’s competitive position.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex market information into strategic business recommendations

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing or equivalent required.

- A 7-10+ years of product management experience considered an asset, preferably gained in the Medical Device industry.

- Fluency in English required and an additional European language preferred.

- Demonstrates strengths in strategic thinking & business acumen.

- At ease in a clinical selling environment.

- Excellent planning and organizational abilities.

- Team player with ability to gain support of colleagues.

- Proven ability to work in a matrixed organization and confidence to lead and influence across multiple organizations/stakeholders.

- Ability to work autonomously and with great initiative & attitude.

- Willing to travel extensively (around 50% travel required).

- Attractive benefits package.

GSMS spans Salesforce/ServiceMax and SAP, so the Magellan transformation reshapes both applications and the integrations between them.

In this role, you will own the vision, scope, and backlog for Capital Equipment Service within Magellan. You will represent the service business across deployments, drive service trade-off, and priority decisions, and ensure that what is designed, built, tested, and deployed enables field service, technical support, service contracting and service-to-cash processes. - Backlog ownership:  Own and prioritize the Magellan service backlog across SAP S/4 and Salesforce/ServiceMax, including carried forward defects and enhancements from prior deployments.
- Trade-off decisions:  Make timely service scope and priority decisions, balancing business value, compliance, program milestones, and team capacity.
- Requirements acceptance:  Set expectations for, review and accept Features, user stories and acceptance criteria written by Business Analysts; confirm Definition of Ready before work enters planning.
- Cross-tower alignment:  Represent service in cross-functional design and integration discussions with Commercial, Order Management, Finance, Logistics, and other towers, making sure end-to-end service-to-cash processes work across both platforms.
- Program governance:  Represent service in Magellan forums (for example Key Design Decisions, architecture reviews, business scope reviews, and Business Change Impact/OCE), and provide status, risks, and dependencies into program governance.
- Solution partnership:  Work with Solution Architects and Functional Analysts to sequence Features and user stories and confirm that proposed solutions meet business intent, without owning technical design.
- Test & release readiness:  Define business test expectations, participate in test readiness and deployment readiness decisions, and accept delivered Features as the business owner.
- Deployment & Change:  Partner with business process owners and change management to identify business change impacts, and support cutover, go-live and hypercare exit for service.
- Stakeholder management:  Build strong relationships with regional service leaders, super users, and business process teams across the US, EMEA, APAC, and other regions.

This role is ideal for someone who is energized by transformation and comfortable making decisions in a complex, multi-team program. You bring a strong business perspective, you can say no as clearly as you say yes, and you know how to keep the service business at the center of design choices across SAP and Salesforce. Purpose Statement
The Principal Product Owner also known as Product Owner Lead, Digital Experience, APAC leads the vision, roadmap, and delivery of the data and metadata architecture layer that underpins APAC’s digital ecosystem. Reporting to the Head of Digital Experience, APAC, the role ensures trusted, governed, and interoperable data flows seamlessly across commercial platforms, workflow engines, analytics solutions, CRM, and enterprise systems to enable informed decision-making and digital transformation across the region.

As the product lead for master data, AI-ready metadata, and intelligent insights capabilities, this role drives the standardization and governance of key data domains while advancing metadata frameworks that support analytics, forecasting, segmentation, and AI-driven decision support. Partnering across Commercial Excellence, Commercial Operations, Data & Analytics, IT, Enterprise Architecture, and market stakeholders, the Principal Product Owner ensures APAC's data architecture delivers scalable insights, operational efficiency, and business value.

Responsibilities:

Product Ownership & Digital Architectural Roadmap
- Own and prioritize the APAC Master Data and Metadata product backlog and roadmap aligned to the regional digital architecture strategy.
- Translate commercial data strategy into clear user stories and scalable architectural design requirements.
- Deliver scalable data products (e.g. master data management tool, analytical tool) that integrate seamlessly into digital workflows.
- Ensure architectural consistency, usability, and interoperability across APAC markets.

Master Data & Governance
- Act as the Product Owner for designated commercial master data domains.
- Define golden record logic, hierarchies, survivorship rules, reference models, and cross-system data standards.
- Establish and maintain canonical data definitions and domain boundaries across platforms.
- Embed governance, stewardship, security, privacy, and control mechanisms into system and workflow design.
- Ensure master data structures support cross-platform integration and downstream analytics scalability.

AI-Ready Metadata & Analytics Enable
- Ensure datasets are architected, structured, documented, and standardized for advanced analytics and AI use.
- Drive semantic layer consistency, governed KPI definitions, lineage transparency, feature definitions, and data contracts across systems.
- Partner with data engineering, analytics, IT, commercial, and finance teams to ensure interoperability between source systems and model-ready data layers.
- Define structural requirements for AI-ready data products to support predictive modeling, automation, and insight generation.

Stakeholder Alignment & Adoption
- Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions align with business priorities.
- Lead prioritization across APAC markets based on architectural impact, business value, and risk mitigation.
- Define measurable KPIs and drive adoption, usage monitoring, and continuous improvement of data capabilities across digital platforms.

Risk & Compliance
- Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance standards and regional privacy regulations.
- Proactively manage data quality risks, cross-platform dependencies, and structural inconsistencies.
- Safeguard architectural integrity by embedding governance standards into digital workflows to reduce downstream risk and technical debt.
- Identify architectural gaps and recommend structural improvements to enhance scalability and resilience.

What we are looking for
- 10 - 15 years of experience in Product Ownership, Data Product Management, Digital Platforms, or related data and technology leadership roles.
- Deep expertise in Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, data modelling, metadata frameworks, semantic layers, and AI-ready data architectures.
- Strong understanding of AI/ML enablement, including the design of data foundations that support advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven decision-making.
- Demonstrated ability to lead data products and platforms from strategy through execution, with strong prioritization and outcome-based decision making.
- Strong systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to connect master data, metadata, analytics, and digital workflows across complex commercial ecosystems.
- Proven ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business value for senior stakeholders.
- Experience identifying and scaling high-impact AI opportunities through effective data and metadata strategies.
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering across Commercial, Data & Analytics, IT, Enterprise Architecture, and regional business teams.
- Effective change leader with experience driving adoption, governance, and accountability for enterprise data capabilities.
- Commercially astute, analytical, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.
- Regional or APAC experience preferred.
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile product management certification preferred.
- Fluency in English required; additional Asian languages are advantageous.
